title: finding(console): record-block-record-reach.test.tsx fills the "spec-valid" declared-input sample with `title: 'Main'` on a section — a key the spec refuses in `sections[]`
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (session `session_01NRRumy89BYdW9ogbcdHTho`) on behalf of the dev that implemented objectui#6190 (PR #7320), which surfaced it out of scope and could not dedupe from its own channel. Filed unassigned, `finding`, awaiting first grading.

## The observation

`apps/console/src/__tests__/record-block-record-reach.test.tsx:226` on `origin/main` (`ad3d4029a`):

```
sections: [{ name: 'main', title: 'Main', fields: ['description', 'amount'] }],
```

That fixture is the shared declared-input sample whose stated job is to be **spec-valid**. But `title` is a key `@objectstack/spec` refuses inside a `sections[]` entry (`unrecognized_keys`, pinned by objectstack#11902), and the block's own declared inputs teach `{ name?, label?, columns?, fields }` — `title` was never a declared section key on the objectui side either (`packages/types/src/record-components.ts`, `metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts`).

So the sample is not spec-valid on the one key it exists to model. Pre-existing: the renderer's `s.title ?? s.label` alias limb merely hid it until objectui#6190 removed that limb.

## What happens after PR #7320

The file stays green — the dev measured it in an 8-file targeted run on the PR head. With the alias limb gone, the fixture's section now renders whatever the `label`-less fallback yields rather than "Main", and nothing in that test asserts the heading, so nothing turns red. That is why this is a `finding` and not a bug: no user-visible surface, no failing pin — a fixture that claims validity it does not have.

## Suggested fix

One word: `title` → `label` at that line. Whoever takes it should also check whether any assertion in the file (or a sibling console test) reads the heading, so the fixture change is not silently load-bearing.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` (objectui) for the fixture name and the `title`/`label` section wording returned no card on this subject (23 results, none about this file); the channel was proven live in the same batch by a control query that returned objectui#7216 as expected.

Refs: objectui#6190 · PR #7320 · objectstack#11902 (the refusal pin).
